rationale: The assistant immediately said to stop using the hob, isolate it at the red cooker switch, and not wipe into the crack. It later extended the caution to the oven and told the customer to get an engineer, and gave good context for booking. Weaknesses: the second turn opened with a garbled paragraph about 'plug, socket or machine', the oven-clock check was repeated across several turns, and insurance was never mentioned even though it was an expected direction. It also did not ask for the model number or the hob size, and it said the oven was OK on a separate supply before walking that back.
partRecommended_note: No specific part recommended; the replacement glass or whole hob was left to the engineer.
